metaDescription: Plan the ultimate trip to Bhutan with our 2026 guide. Discover the best attractions, food, neighborhoods, and hidden gems.

content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Bhutan. Whether you are planning a trip to Bhutan for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore Bhutan depends on what you want to experience. Summer offers long days perfect for outdoor adventures.

## Top Attractions

- Famous attractions that define Bhutan
- Hidden spots only locals know about
- Natural sites that tell the story of Bhutan
- Scenic vistas for unforgettable photos

![Bhutan landscape](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555821108-3fb2763b226a?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Local Cuisine

No trip to Bhutan is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

A mix of public transport and occasional taxis offers the best balance of convenience and cost in Bhutan.

## Where to Stay

Book early during peak season to secure the best places to stay in Bhutan.
